id./param/scenario/cs/a_130_cs_170.pack|cs_: "Well, well... I guess we saved the day again!
"What is happening, please!? So many people are coming out of the ruins!
"You have done something to our mural! Where is it!? Tell me!
"We're free... We're back in the real world! Thank crikey for that! And don't come back, you stupid painting!
"'The real world'? What is he talking about, please?
"No! You are lying! The mural did all these terrible things!?
"If this is true, we owe you a great debt, friends. You must stay at our inn again tonight, free of charge!
